grader.scenario: Parental web safety filter blocking university medical genetics research portal; resolved via custom domain exception and policy push
grader.notes: Flawless call featuring deep empathy in middle third, custom domain whitelist provisioning, harmless recheck in final third, and complete live download verification.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net broadband customer services' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with could I place you on hold and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Victor throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated profound empathy at turn 22 regarding customer's doctoral dissertation deadline and medical fellowship, and no unhandled outbursts occurred.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent accurately paraphrased the content filter misclassification issue at turn 2.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent completed harmless recheck of customer address at turn 42.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent applied custom domain exception, pushed cloud policy update, submitted central heuristic override, and verified live dataset download.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained an exemplary, warm, and highly supportive professional demeanor throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent probed about the exact URL and domain triggering the block screen.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer logged in via Single Sign-On and successfully downloaded the 250MB dataset live on call.
